mission.title: A Mistake
mission.description: Identify a wireframed intruder who has entered the Matrix, then track her down.

npc.say: I did make a mistake. The Matrix was more than I had thought it was. But you know that now too, don't you?
Her possession of offensive Oligarch override codes has not been established.

phase.briefing: Operative, another wireframed individual has entered the Matrix. It is necessary to identify this intruder immediately. Please note that their RSI is female.

enter.say:
Don't ask who told me, but rumors in the Merv camp say this is Danielle Wright, the crazy Zionite inventor who was taken out by Sentinels not too long after the Truce ended. Just how she--
Oh, you're there. Okay, check it out. We had an emergency call from there earlier, but something appears to have gone wrong...

done.say:
Oh, damn it. Which way did they point? You sure? Okay, I'll have Gray check.
And I'm calling an ambulance, too.
Override code has been detected along that vector, operative. Investigate and report.

talk.say: Looking for something? So am I. I think you know what it is.

done.say: Gray's trying to get our attention. I think we're supposed to clear out.

near.say: He wasn't kidding when he said there was override activity. It's hot in there.

phase.briefing: {player}, at this juncture I believe that a brief discussion concerning the intruder is in order.

talk.say: Is there something you need, {player}? The Agent is waiting for you.

The data returned from your proximity to the intruder corresponds closely enough to characteristics of the ex-Zionite Danielle Wright that we find it likely that this is indeed her. How she survived termination by Sentinels is unknown, but there is no question that their sensors had confirmed her body destroyed.
Also, we must be clear that Wright is not a member of the group termed "Oligarchs"; evidence suggests that she has adopted their jack-in protocol, but the use of force against her person is not prohibited, and the termination order previously issued for her must be considered still in effect. Operatives have been brought to assist you in enforcing it.
I think they've parked a couple greenhorns in the outer office for you.

phase.briefing: Obviously, we would like this handled as swiftly as possible, {player}.

enter.say: They've been tracking Wright since we located her earlier. I'm getting plenty of override interference in there.

near.say: Great... Well, now we know that she can at least override the programs she finds here, like the earlier intruders could.

Damn, she must have taken a powder at some point and left that program in her place. So there's another override trick we know she can do. It's looking to me like she's got all the override capabilities Halborn and Carlyne had...which means we're in the deep stuff yet again.
Anyway, look, just take care of those Exiles. We can leave the big ball for another team.

mission.finish:
Yes. I see.
Very well, operative; you are excused. Wright's termination will require further planning.
